display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
User fills repair request form:
- Machine serial number
- Purchase date
- Issue description
- Photos/videos of issue
- Warranty status check

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Admin reviews request:
- Validates warranty period
- Checks purchase records
- Reviews issue description
- May request additional info

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Repair scheduling:
- Assign technician
- Schedule drop-off/pickup
- Send confirmation to user

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Repair execution:
- Diagnose issue
- Order parts if needed
- Perform repair
- Quality check

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Return shipping:
- Generate tracking number
- Ship via courier
- User can track status

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Completion:
- User confirms device works
- Close repair ticket
- Request feedback survey
